# bloxone_cdc_sources (Data Source)

Retrieves information about existing Sources of all types.

The Source object represents where Cloud Data Connector (CDC) collects data from. This includes the built-in Infoblox Cloud Source (_SOURCE_BLOXONE_) and Schedule Source (_SOURCE_SCHEDULE_), which exist in every account and cannot be managed by Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get the built-in Infoblox Cloud Source
data "bloxone_cdc_sources" "cloud" {
  filters = {
    type = "SOURCE_BLOXONE"
  }
}

# Get the built-in Schedule Source
data "bloxone_cdc_sources" "schedule" {
  filters = {
    type = "SOURCE_SCHEDULE"
  }
}

# Get CDC Sources filtered by name
data "bloxone_cdc_sources" "example_by_name" {
  filters = {
    name = "example_cdc_source_nios"
  }
}

# Get all CDC Sources
data "bloxone_cdc_sources" "example_all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) Filter are used to return a more specific list of results. Filters can be used to match resources by specific attributes, e.g. name. If you specify multiple filters, the results returned will have only resources that match all the specified filters.
- `tag_filters` (Map of String) Tag Filters are used to return a more specific list of results filtered by tags. If you specify multiple filters, the results returned will have only resources that match all the specified filters.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Time when the object has been created.
- `description` (String) The description of the source.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether the source is enabled.
- `id` (Number) The resource identifier.
- `name` (String) The name of the source.
- `tags` (Map of String) The tags for the source.
- `type` (String) The type of the source, e.g. _SOURCE_BLOXONE_ (Infoblox Cloud Source), _SOURCE_SCHEDULE_ (Schedule Source) or _SOURCE_NIOS_.
- `updated_at` (String) Time when the object has been updated. Equals to _created_at_ if not updated after creation.
